A considered perspective

Across industries.
Beyond the hype.

The same questions recur across legal, health, insurance and financial services: Where does responsibility sit? What counts as evidence? When must a human decide?

AI Legal is a space to investigate those questions through independent writing and experimental software. Operated by AILL LLC, doing business as AI Legal.
